title: The CyberUnicorn console keeps answering while the live screen streams

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21 in the project thread, 0.1.3: 'The CyberUnicorn stopped answering' on a placard write with a scrambled live screen. The auto-sent device log (LIVE-1224) shows binary screen bytes landing in the text log right after `display start`, then no RPC reply.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. PREMISE: Web Serial opened with Chrome's default 255-byte read buffer. Firmware 0.1.3 streams every draw call losslessly over USB, the buffer overran, bytes were dropped, and the demux (which only checked the fn byte) then took stray 0xAA colour bytes for packet headers and swallowed the text after them, RPC replies included. Now the port opens with a 1 MB buffer, a read error starts the demux and text decoder clean and logs '# USB read error', and the demux only accepts a packet whose size matches its draw function (tftLogger.cpp layouts).

verify.note: Fails when the port loses its large buffer, a read error stops resetting the demux, or the demux stops checking packet sizes.
